dispositions.finding_summary: S02 said archived items are both excluded from and included in filter=archived; S03 promised no-repeats while encoding only an (updatedAt,id) cursor, with no stated clock limitation and ambiguous data-page semantics.
dispositions.policy_choice: S02: archived items are excluded from the default/active list; filter=archived shows archived only; filter=all both; unknown filter value → 400 (same explicit-parameter policy as C2); archive/restore touch only archived_at (version/updated_at unchanged). S03: published realizable model — keyset cursor, no-repeats-within-a-walk guaranteed under monotonic updated_at (backward server clock explicitly outside the model), live-keyset skip tolerance (mid-walk updates skip items until a fresh walk; new items don't appear mid-walk), no snapshot/seen-ID promises; data-page = pages-loaded-so-far counter.
